_about: Public-domain Benjamin Keach (1640-1704, Particular Baptist pastor at Horsleydown, Southwark, champion of congregational hymn singing) for the Word Hoard: An Exposition of the Parables (London: Aylott, 1858), Tropologia, a Key to Open Scripture Metaphors (Bonmahon, Ireland, for Collingridge, London, 1858; the title page names Keach alone), A Golden Mine Opened (1694), The Breach Repaired in God's Worship (1691) and Gold Refined, or Baptism in its Primitive Purity (1689), raw Internet Archive OCR (the three seventeenth-century printings are in long s). Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 13 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
